verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin library that installs into other vendors' CLIs and harnesses (Claude Code, Devin CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex). It exposes in-session slash commands such as /brainstorm and /execute-plan, but the evidence never shows a standalone first-party Superpowers CLI. A plugin framework could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.
